title: TFTP Revision 2
publisher: USA Standard Code for Information Interchange (USASI) X3.4-1968
copyright: {C} Karen R. Sollins, Massachusetts Institute of Technology Laboratory for Computer Science
abstract: This document describes TFTP Revision 2, which provides enhanced functionality, improved error handling, and a more robust data transfer mechanism. It introduces new packet types, including the WRQ, DATA, ACK, and ERROR packets, as well as a mechanism for normal termination and error handling. The document also discusses the use of transfer identifiers (TIDs) for source and destination ports, aligning TFTP with the Internet User Datagram Protocol (UDP).
